# SOLVE vertical slice

**User outcome:** <!-- One real task an unfamiliar person can complete. -->

**Before:** <!-- Grounded current behavior; include evidence/URL, not assumptions. -->

**Owner / scope:** <!-- One agent, branch, affected paths. -->

**Minimal completion path:** <!-- UI → authority → persistence → failure/recovery as relevant. -->

**Acceptance proof:** <!-- What automated and real-use evidence would demonstrate success? -->

**Independence test:** <!-- What must work without AI, card, signup, payments or other unrelated modules? -->

**Security / privacy boundaries:** <!-- Access and authorization consequences. -->

**Dependency / possible duplication:** <!-- Reference existing issue/PR/module. -->

**Learning to preserve:** <!-- Required regression guard / reusable discovery after completion. -->

**Next step:** <!-- One owner and one next action; do not add a sprawling roadmap. -->
